title: Responsible Business Conduct (Directions on Collection Practices and Recovery Conduct)
description: <cite index="43-2,43-3">RBI consolidated recovery instructions across entity-specific rulebooks into one standard applicable to banks, NBFCs and housing finance companies. Key changes include an updated definition of recovery agency, mandatory compensation policies for borrowers, and prohibition of device locking with narrow exceptions.</cite> Commencement effective January 1, 2027.
